literal_meaning: মুখের মতো (মুখের অনুরূপ বা মুখের উপযোগী)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথায় মুখের মতো জবাব দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He gave a fitting reply to his words.
This decision turned out just right.
note: Often used in contexts of verbal exchanges to denote a precise or deserved comeback.
